# Tiny C Compiler (TCC)

TCC is a small, fast C compiler that supports ANSI C (C99) and many GNU C extensions.

## Features

- **Small**: Extremely compact C compiler
- **Fast**: Generates machine code directly, compiles ~10x faster than `gcc -O0`
- **Complete**: Full C preprocessor, ANSI C99 support, GNU C extensions
- **C scripting**: Can compile and run C source directly with `-run`
- **Self-hosting**: TCC can compile itself
- **Multi-architecture**: Supports i386, x86_64, ARM, AArch64, RISC-V
- **Dynamic library support**: Any C dynamic library can be used directly
- **Optional bounds checker**: Memory and bounds checking for debugging

## Usage

### Compile a C file to an executable
```
tcc -o output input.c
```

### Compile and run directly (C scripting)
```
tcc -run input.c [arguments...]
```

### Use as a C script interpreter
Add `#!/usr/local/bin/tcc -run` as the first line of your C source.

### Compile to object file only
```
tcc -c -o output.o input.c
```

### Preprocessor options
```
tcc -Idir        # Add include path
tcc -Dsym[=val]  # Define preprocessor symbol
tcc -Usym        # Undefine preprocessor symbol
```

### Linker options
```
tcc -Ldir        # Add library path
tcc -lname       # Link with library
tcc -shared      # Generate shared library
tcc -soname name # Set shared library internal name
tcc -static      # Generate statically linked executable
```

### Warning and debug options
```
tcc -w           # Disable all warnings
tcc -Wall        # Enable common warnings
tcc -Werror      # Treat warnings as errors
tcc -g           # Generate debug information
tcc -b           # Enable bounds checking
tcc -bt N        # Show N callers in bound checker
```

### Other options
```
tcc -v           # Show version
tcc -vv          # Show search paths or loaded files
tcc -bench       # Show compilation statistics
tcc -            # Read source from stdin
```

TCC is a small, fast C compiler that supports ANSI C (C99) and many GNU C extensions.

## Features

- **Small**: Extremely compact C compiler
- **Fast**: Generates machine code directly, compiles ~10x faster than `gcc -O0`
- **Complete**: Full C preprocessor, ANSI C99 support, GNU C extensions
- **C scripting**: Can compile and run C source directly with `-run`
- **Self-hosting**: TCC can compile itself
- **Multi-architecture**: Supports i386, x86_64, ARM, AArch64, RISC-V
- **Dynamic library support**: Any C dynamic library can be used directly
- **Optional bounds checker**: Memory and bounds checking for debugging

## Usage

### Compile a C file to an executable
```
tcc -o output input.c
```

### Compile and run directly (C scripting)
```
tcc -run input.c [arguments...]
```

### Use as a C script interpreter
Add `#!/usr/local/bin/tcc -run` as the first line of your C source.

### Compile to object file only
```
tcc -c -o output.o input.c
```

### Preprocessor options
```
tcc -Idir        # Add include path
tcc -Dsym[=val]  # Define preprocessor symbol
tcc -Usym        # Undefine preprocessor symbol
```

### Linker options
```
tcc -Ldir        # Add library path
tcc -lname       # Link with library
tcc -shared      # Generate shared library
tcc -soname name # Set shared library internal name
tcc -static      # Generate statically linked executable
```

### Warning and debug options
```
tcc -w           # Disable all warnings
tcc -Wall        # Enable common warnings
tcc -Werror      # Treat warnings as errors
tcc -g           # Generate debug information
tcc -b           # Enable bounds checking
tcc -bt N        # Show N callers in bound checker
```

### Other options
```
tcc -v           # Show version
tcc -vv          # Show search paths or loaded files
tcc -bench       # Show compilation statistics
tcc -            # Read source from stdin
```
